entities.summary: Daniel Lawrence Lurie is an American politician and philanthropist who is the 46th and incumbent mayor of San Francisco, serving since 2025. He was elected in 2024, defeating then-incumbent London Breed. He is the founder and former CEO of Tipping Point Community.
